brief_summary: Childhood obesity and related long-term effects are serious public health problems, but not all children with obesity do well in treatment. This study will test a new combination of family-based behavioral treatment (FBT) with a drug intervention using a glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1RA) exenatide once weekly extended-release (ExQW, Bydureon®) in order to improve obesity intervention outcomes in 10-12-year-old children.
brief_title: Brain Activation and Satiety in Children 2
official_title: Brain Systems and Behaviors Underlying Response to Obesity Treatment in Children

primary_outcomes.time_frame: Change from drug treatment randomization at week 8 of family-based behavioral treatment (FBT) to end of combined intervention (FBT + drug) at week 24 of FBT
